title: Powers of matrices with all principal minors equal to 1
summary: We say that a square matrix $A$ is \emph{$1$-principled} if all its principal minors are equal to $1$. We show that over any well-behaved ring, any power $A^m$ of a $1$-principled matrix $A$ is again $1$-principled. Well-behaved rings include all reduced rings as well as all quotients of commutative rings modulo integrally closed ideals; in particular, all fields and all quotients of $\mathbb{Z}$ are well-behaved.
